meta.name: ray-train
meta.description: Distributed training orchestration across clusters. Scales PyTorch/TensorFlow/HuggingFace from laptop to 1000s of nodes. Built-in hyperparameter tuning with Ray Tune, fault tolerance, elastic scaling. Use when training massive models across multiple machines or running distributed hyperparameter sweeps.

copy.tagline: 跨集群编排分布式训练，从单机扩展到数千节点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多台机器上训练大规模模型或运行分布式超参搜索

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你把 PyTorch、TensorFlow 或 HuggingFace 的训练代码从单机扩展到多机多卡集群，自动处理分布式协调、GPU 分配、容错和检查点。
howto.when: 当你需要训练大型模型，或者想在多台机器上运行分布式超参数搜索时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Ray Train 在 4 台机器上训练这个 PyTorch 模型。
say.note: Claude 会生成多节点训练代码。

say.text: 用 Ray Tune 对学习率和批次大小做超参数搜索。
say.note: Claude 会生成分布式超参数调优代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you scale PyTorch, TensorFlow, or HuggingFace training code from a single machine to multi-node multi-GPU clusters, automatically handling distributed coordination, GPU allocation, fault tolerance, and checkpointing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to train large models or run distributed hyperparameter sweeps across multiple machines.

say_en.text: Help me train this PyTorch model on 4 machines using Ray Train.
say_en.note: Claude will generate multi-node training code.

say_en.text: Use Ray Tune to do hyperparameter search on learning rate and batch size.
say_en.note: Claude will generate distributed hyperparameter tuning code.
